sloka: आनय त्वं हि तां सीतां मत्तो ऽहं मैथिलीकृते ।न मे दास्यसि चेत्सीतां यथारूपां महीतले ।। ७.९८.९ ॥
transliteration: ānaya tvaṁ hi tāṁ sītāṁ matto 'haṁ maithilīkṛte ।na me dāsyasi cetsītāṁ yathārūpāṁ mahītale ।। 7.98.9 ॥

translations.english: You must indeed bring that Sita, as I am maddened for Maithili's sake; if you do not give Sita to me in her true form on the surface of the earth, then...
